`candidate-primary` now holds `dev` at b24c499, with `code/`, `results/` and `code/README.md`. The built PDF (`dev/built-from`, b24c499) has 19 pages in total. I did not re-check that the main text still fits in 9 pages. It had about 90 pt spare before this merge, and the merge changed nothing under `paper/`. No "??" remain in the PDF.

PR #5 still needs `venue-repo` to re-review the new head. I commented on the PR asking for that. `figtab-repo` and `idea-repo` approved the earlier head, and the paper text is unchanged.

The pipeline-grid results (P2–P6) and the Open LLM Leaderboard transfer check are not in `results/` yet. The paper still says nothing about either.

Once #5 is approved and merged into `main`, I'll open the `main` → `release` PR.
